verses.text: A message from the LORD to Israel, delivered through Malachi.
The LORD says, “I have loved you.” You ask, “How have you loved us?” He replies, “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother? Yet I loved Jacob,”
“but I hated Esau. I left his mountains in ruins and gave his inheritance to the jackals of the wilderness.”

Edom may say, “We’ve been knocked down, but we’ll rebuild these ruins.” But the LORD of Armies says, “They can build; I will tear it down again. People will call them a wicked land, a people under the LORD’s anger forever.”
You’ll see it with your own eyes and say, “The LORD is great, even beyond Israel’s border!”

“A son honors his father, and a servant honors his master. If I’m a father, where is my honor? If I’m a master, where is the respect due to me?” says the LORD of Armies to you priests who dishonor my name. “But you ask, ‘How have we dishonored your name?’”
“You bring defiled food to my altar. Then you ask, ‘How have we defiled you?’ You’ve done it by calling the LORD’s table unworthy of respect.”

“When you sacrifice a blind animal, isn’t that wrong? When you offer a lame or sick one, isn’t that wrong too? Try giving it to your governor. Would he welcome you or accept you?” says the LORD of Armies.
“Go ahead and ask God to show you favor. But with offerings like these, will he accept any of you?” says the LORD of Armies.
“I wish someone would shut the temple doors! Then you couldn’t light fires on my altar for nothing. I take no pleasure in you, and I won’t accept an offering from you,” says the LORD of Armies.
“From sunrise to sunset, my name is honored among the nations. Everywhere, incense and a pure offering are brought in my name, because my name is great among the nations,” says the LORD of Armies.
“But you insult my name by saying, ‘The LORD’s table is defiled, and its food is worthless.’”
“You also say, ‘What a burden!’ and sneer at it,” says the LORD of Armies. “You bring animals taken by violence, along with the lame and sick. Should I accept those from you?” says the LORD.

“Cursed is the cheater who has a healthy male in his flock, makes a vow, and then sacrifices a defective animal to the Lord. I am a great King,” says the LORD of Armies, “and nations everywhere stand in awe of my name.”
